CHIEF COMPLAINT: Headache for 3 days.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS: 31-year-old with bilateral, band-like headache, no aura, no vision changes. Denies trauma. Mild stress at work recently.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS: Negative for fever, neck stiffness, vision changes, weakness. Positive for headache.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: No chronic conditions.

VITALS: BP 118/76, HR 72, Temp 98.3F, RR 14.

PHYSICAL EXAM: Neurological exam grossly intact, no focal deficits, no neck stiffness, no papilledema on fundoscopic exam.

PLAN: OTC analgesics, hydration, stress management, return if headache worsens or new neuro symptoms develop.
